An employee is helping another customer select paint, pointing at color samples on the wall. The employee helping with paint appears older than the stock worker. The wall displays four wallpaper samples and a variety of paint samples. The number of paint samples is two more than the number of wallpaper samples. A cashier is scanning items while standing behind a counter. The counter holds two business cards and a stack of receipts. The number of receipts is three times the number of business cards. A stock worker is organizing nuts and bolts into bins while wearing an apron. One bin contains five bolts, and the number of nuts in that same bin is two less than the number of bolts. A customer is testing the weight of a hammer. A manager is checking inventory, holding a clipboard and pointing at empty shelves.
